name: North Atlantic Current
scope: NOAA glossary regional continuation from the vicinity of 40 degrees N, 50 degrees W southeast of Grand Banks toward the western approaches of the British Isles. OSW chooses a nominal terminal gate west of Ireland, with southern/northern approach alternatives. Excludes Gulf Stream upstream, branches toward Iceland, the onward Norwegian/Canary flows and recirculation. A selected approach route is not the length of the entire branching Gulf Stream System.
layer: Regional upper-ocean reference geography; no depth-specific velocity axis diagnosed.
time_convention: Undated editorial sketch under a glossary naming convention; not a synoptic path, parcel trajectory or climatological current axis.
source_locator: North Atlantic Current entry: start near 40 degrees N, 50 degrees W, continuation toward British Isles, membership of Gulf Stream System and onward Norwegian/Canary flows.
source_citation: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services, Tides and Currents Glossary, North Atlantic Current entry (accessed 2026-10-02).
source_license: Factual regional geography only; no source map, curve, provider geometry or velocity field packaged.
coordinate_selection: NOAA supplies a broad start and British Isles destination; OSW selects all intermediate vertices and exact approach gates. Alternatives are regional terminal conventions, not observed northern/southern current branches. No single reconstructed axis or universal termination is implied.

alternative_routes.interpretation: OSW southern British Isles approach convention; not a measured branch centerline.
OSW northern British Isles approach convention; not an observed branch or onward Norwegian Current extent.

scenario_rule: Three regional terminal-route conventions crossed with three longitude offsets (-0.5/0/+0.5 degrees) and independent endpoint latitude offsets (-0.5/0/+0.5 degrees): 81 editorial scenarios. Latitude/longitude offsets do not represent empirical positional uncertainty or include all meanders and branches.
remaining_gates: Independent oceanographic review of naming limits, Grand Banks region and British Isles approach-route alternatives.
Validate intermediate geography against reproducible upper-ocean velocity/front geometry and account for omitted meanders.
Canonical admission and publication review; preserve distinction from the full Gulf Stream System.
method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 81 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
